note: Regenerated 2026-10-14 (wave six) by probing the live endpoint after the structured output deploy (MCP structured output wave) reached production. The previous edition of this record described the build probed earlier that day, which predated that code: it reported no structuredContent in tools/call results, no icon or documentation address in initialize, and no outputSchema in tools/list. All three are live now and are recorded verbatim below. The one identity value still in transition is the icon: the live server at probe time returns the 180 by 180 touch icon address, and the code change pointing the server identity at the 512 by 512 mark served from the site root (https://askcerebrum.org/icon-512.png) is written but was not yet deployed when these probes ran. After that deploy lands, rerun the initialize and GET probes and update the two icon values in this file.

rateLimitFromCode: functions/api/mcp.js enforces MCP_RATE_LIMIT = 20 requests per MCP_RATE_WINDOW_MS = 60000 ms per client IP (KV backed checkRateLimit, key prefix mcp). Over the limit the HTTP status is 429, the JSON RPC error code is -32000 with message "Rate limit exceeded", and the response carries Retry-After: 30. If the rate limit store itself throws, the endpoint falls back to a bounded in memory limiter (checkRateLimitMemoryOnly) at the same numbers rather than failing open or closed. Not retested live in this round: the earlier same day probes already confirmed the 429 shape, and the probe budget is itself rate limited.
resultAnatomyFromCode: A successful tools/call result carries content (one text block), structuredContent shaped by the tool's declared outputSchema, and isError false, as observed live above. The search text block is the answer followed by a numbered source list and, when a Search record was stored, its address; when the upstream search failed or timed out, the same envelope ships with isError true and a plain language failure text (and no structuredContent on the error path).
